title: Legacy Copy Services
items: Starting from which version do policy-based replication and policy-based HA replace the remote-copy function?
自 8.7.1 起，Policy-based Replication 與 Policy-based HA 取代 Remote Copy，Volume Group Snapshot 取代 FlashCopy。
Volume Group Snapshot 取代 FlashCopy 功能。
What replaces legacy FlashCopy-based Safeguarded Copy?
Safeguarded snapshots created by the snapshot policy internal scheduler
FlashCopy 為基礎的 Safeguarded Copy 改由 Snapshot Policy 內部排程建立的 Safeguarded Snapshot 取代。
What does the FlashCopy function create?
A point-in-time copy of data on a source volume to a target volume
A synchronous mirror to a remote system
FlashCopy 將 Source Volume 的時間點資料複製到 Target Volume；Target 原有資料會被取代。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch14 FlashCopy function
Must the source and target volumes of a FlashCopy mapping be in the same I/O group or pool?
FlashCopy Mapping 可建立於系統內任兩個 Volume，不需同 I/O Group 或 Pool。
What happens when a FlashCopy operation starts?
A checkpoint and bitmap are created; no data is copied at that moment
啟動時只建立 Checkpoint 與 Bitmap，不立即複製資料。
What does each bit in the FlashCopy bitmap represent?
One grain of the source volume
Bitmap 每一位元代表 Source Volume 的一個區域，稱為 Grain。
During a read from the target, what happens if the grain has not been copied?
The data is read from the source volume
The grain is copied first, then read from the target
若 Grain 尚未複製，讀取 Target 時會從 Source 讀取資料。
When new data is written to the source after FlashCopy starts, what happens first?
The existing data on the source grain is copied to the target before the new write
The new data is written to the target
寫入 Source 前，系統會先把該 Grain 的舊資料複製到 Target，再寫入新資料並更新 Bitmap。
What is the range of FlashCopy mapping copy rate values?
FlashCopy Mapping 的 Copy Rate 可從 128 KBps 到 2 GBps，且可在任何狀態下變更。
Which write method does the FlashCopy function use by default?
FlashCopy 使用 Copy-on-write 完成對 Source 的寫入；符合條件時自動使用 Redirect-on-write。
Which condition is required for the system to automatically activate redirect-on-write (RoW)?
Source and target in the same data reduction pool with deduplication enabled, same I/O group, and not mirrored
Source and target in different pools
RoW 需 Source 與 Target 位於同一啟用 Deduplication 的 DRP、同一 I/O Group 且都未 Mirror。
What are the possible FlashCopy grain sizes?
Grain Size 可為 64 KB 或 256 KB，建立 Mapping 後不可更改。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch14 Grains
When is the default grain size 64?
When neither volume is in another mapping and at least one volume is compressed
When the target is in a child pool
兩個 Volume 都沒有既有 Mapping 且至少一個是壓縮 Volume 時，預設 Grain 為 64；其他情況預設 256。
If one of the volumes is already part of a FlashCopy mapping and grain size is not specified, what grain size is used?
The grain size of the existing mapping
未指定 Grain 且其中一個 Volume 已屬於其他 Mapping 時，沿用該 Mapping 的 Grain Size。
At least how much data is copied every time a write is made to the source?
系統每次寫入 Source 至少複製 256 KB，因此 4 KB 小寫入會被放大成 256 KB 的複製。
How many FlashCopy mappings can a source volume belong to at most?
一個 Source Volume 最多可屬於 256 個 FlashCopy Mapping。
Which situation makes the Create mapping event fail?
The source and target volumes are different sizes
The target is in a different pool
The source is in a different I/O group
Source 已屬於 256 個 Mapping、Node Bitmap 記憶體不足或兩 Volume 大小不同時，Create 會失敗。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch14 Table 44
Why can the prepare command corrupt data on the target volume?
Prepare 會捨棄 Cache 中的寫入，即使從未 Start，Target 資料也可能在邏輯上改變。
When does a FlashCopy mapping move from preparing to prepared?
Automatically after the source cache is flushed and target cache is invalidated (Flush done)
Flush done：Source Cache 寫回完成且 Target Cache 失效後，Mapping 自動由 preparing 進入 prepared。
During the start command for a consistency group, what happens to new reads and writes to source volumes?
They are paused in the cache layer until ongoing I/O below the cache completes
They are sent to the target
Start 時新讀寫會在 Cache 層暫停，直到 Cache 以下進行中的 I/O 完成，以確保跨 Volume 一致性。
Which property of a FlashCopy mapping can be modified?
可修改的屬性包括名稱、Clean Rate、Consistency Group、Copy Rate 與背景複製完成後自動刪除。
What is required to delete a FlashCopy mapping in the stopped state?
刪除 stopped 狀態的 FlashCopy Mapping 必須使用 force 旗標。
What happens if the flush of cache data cannot complete?
The mapping enters the stopped state
Flush failed：無法完成 Cache 寫回時，Mapping 進入 stopped 狀態。
When is the mapping state set to copied?
After all source data is copied to the target and there are no dependent mappings
所有 Source 資料複製到 Target 且沒有相依 Mapping 時，狀態設為 copied。
How does FlashCopy completion speed relate to disk performance?
It is in direct proportion to the performance of the source and target disks
It depends only on the target
It depends only on the host
FlashCopy 完成速度與 Source、Target 磁碟效能成正比；快 Source 配慢 Target 會拖慢 Source 寫入。
Which I/O type has a much higher impact during FlashCopy?
隨機寫入的影響遠大於循序寫入，因每個小寫入都要複製整個 256 KB Grain。
How can you limit bottlenecks for FlashCopy source and target volumes?
Spread them across as many storage pools as possible
Put all targets in one pool
將 FlashCopy Source 與 Target 盡量分散到多個 Storage Pool，可降低單一儲存的瓶頸。
For volumes in incremental FlashCopy mappings, which volume must be expanded first?
Incremental Mapping 的兩個 Volume 都可擴充，但必須先擴充 Target。
Can thin-provisioned and standard-provisioned volumes be mixed in FlashCopy mappings?
Thin 與 Standard Volume 可在 Mapping 中混用，常見為 Standard Source 搭配 Thin Target。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch14 Thin-provisioned FlashCopy
For best performance, what should match the grain size of the FlashCopy mapping?
The grain size of the thin-provisioned volume
Thin Volume 的 Grain Size 與 Mapping 一致時效能最佳；不一致仍可運作。
With a standard-provisioned source and thin-provisioned target, what should the background copy and cleaning rates be?
需將 Background Copy Rate 與 Cleaning Rate 都設為 0，否則整個 Source 會被複製。
If background copy is left enabled with a standard source and thin target, what can happen?
The thin target goes offline or grows as large as the source
整個 Source 會被複製到 Thin Target，使其離線或長到與 Source 一樣大。
A thin source volume has an 800 GB virtual size, 100 GB real size, and 50 GB used. How much is copied?
僅 Thin Source 時只複製已使用的空間，因此只複製 50 GB。
For a thin volume with 1 TB virtual size and 100 MB real capacity, what must the FlashCopy bitmap cover?
Bitmap 對每個 Grain 都有一位元，因此要涵蓋 1 TB 的虛擬大小。
What is the main purpose of the Safeguarded Copy function?
Isolating backup copies from production data so you can quickly recover after a cyberattack
Safeguarded Copy 將備份與正式資料 Isolation，遭受網路攻擊時可快速復原。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch14 Legacy Safeguarded Copy
Under separation of duties, what can users with the Administrator role NOT do?
Remove or change existing Safeguarded snapshots
Administrator 可佈建與設定 Safeguarded Copy 及相關物件，但不能移除或變更既有 Safeguarded Snapshot。
Why is it recommended to create a new Administrator user to configure Safeguarded snapshots?
為了 Audit，建議另建專責的 Administrator 使用者設定 Safeguarded 功能。
Which role can remove and change Safeguarded backups and backup locations?
Security Administrator 可管理整個系統的使用者與安全，並可移除與變更 Safeguarded Backup 與 Backup Location。
When Two Person Integrity (TPI) is enabled, what does the Security Administrator role become?
啟用 TPI 時 Security Administrator 變為 Restricted Security Administrator，關鍵作業需兩位安全管理者共同完成。
Can Safeguarded copies be mapped directly to hosts?
Protected Copies：Safeguarded Copy 不能直接映射給 Host，以防應用程式變更。
Which IBM tool coordinates and automates Safeguarded Copy across systems, requiring version 6.3.4 or later?
IBM Copy Services Manager 可跨系統協調並自動化，需 6.3.4 以上。
Which IBM product combines copy data functions with ransomware detection?
IBM Storage Sentinel 結合 Copy Data 功能與 Ransomware 偵測；Storage Copy Data Management 管理應用程式一致的 Safeguarded Copy。
What should be done after Safeguarded Copy is configured?
Test it regularly to ensure backups are usable during an attack
設定完成後應定期測試，確保攻擊發生時備份可用。
I/O amplification and magnification and FlashCopy I/O latency at the FlashCopy layer
FlashCopy 統計量測 FlashCopy 層的 I/O Amplification 與 Magnification，以及 FlashCopy I/O 的 Latency，供 Support 分析。
What unit do FlashCopy aggregate time statistics (XXag) use?
Aggregate 統計包括累計時間 (XXag) 與最大時間 (XXmx)，單位為微秒。
Which FlashCopy statistic type is reset after each sample period?
最大值於每個取樣期間後重設；Aggregate 與 Count 為累計值，Count 不會重設。
How can the average response time be calculated from FlashCopy statistics?
By taking two statistics files and using the cumulative aggregate and count values
From a single file's maximum value
Aggregate 與 Count 為累計值，取兩個檔案相減即可算出平均回應時間。
What does FlashCopy target data availability look like after start?
Data on the target is available immediately, even while copying
Data is available only after full copy
The target is offline until copied
雖然複製需要時間，但 Target 資料立即可用，尚在複製的資料可從 Source 取得。
FlashCopy is sometimes described as which type of copy technology?
FlashCopy 常被稱為 Time-zero (T0) 或 Point-in-time Copy 技術。
